en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 1. Muḥammad ibn ‘Abdillāh ibn Ja’far Al-Ḥimyari narrated to me from Abī Sa’īd Ḥasan ibn ‘Ali ibn Zakariyyā Al-‘Adawi Al-Basri, from Haytham ibn ‘Abdillāh Al-Rummāni, from Abil Ḥasan (Imam Riďā (a.s.)), from his father (Imam Kāżim (a.s.)), who said:

Abū ‘Abdillāh, Ja’far ibn Muḥammad Al-Sādiq (a.s.) said: The days spent by those who go to the Ziyārah of Ḥusain (a.s.) are not counted as part of their lives; they do not reduce from their time (to death).
